evidence.name: Screen field: Unselected item look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Unselected item look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Unselected item look
sections.description: The default look of each choice before it's tapped — background, border, corner radius, and an optional gradient. Keep it neutral and calm so the selected state can stand out; the contrast between this and the selected look is what tells visitors their tap registered. Pair it with the Selected item look.
